description.value: Ezawa's African Market is a general grocery store specializing in African food products, located in a commercial unit on Edmonds Street in Burnaby. It offers a niche selection of African pantry staples and goods not commonly found in mainstream supermarkets. A touring cyclist passing through would find it a distinctive stop for specialty provisions.

address.value: 7487 Edmonds Street, Unit K&L, Burnaby, BC
